title: Maestría en Gerencia en Salud
about: Universidad Peruana Cayetano Heredia's distance-learning Master's in Health Management (20 months, weekly sessions) is taking registrations for the 2027-1 cycle until 1 March 2027, with admission from 4 to 8 March and classes starting 29 March 2027.
requirements: Copy of bachelor's degree or professional title (also required of foreign applicants)

upskill.name: Domain-Specific Analytics I
why: Field 'Health management' → objective 'Explore healthcare and clinical analytics applications involving electronic health records, genomics, and epidemiological data.'

card_alt: Card for the Maestría en Gerencia en Salud, a distance-learning programme at Universidad Peruana Cayetano Heredia (UPCH), Lima, Peru, with registrations until 1 Mar 2027. The photo shows the striped Rainbow Mountain (Vinicunca) in the Cusco region of Peru, not Lima.
